<action type="say">
I don’t have direct access to your bank’s systems, so I can’t see or display your live balance myself. I can walk you through how to check it quickly:

On your bank’s mobile app:
1. Open the app and sign in.
2. On the home / accounts screen, look for your “Checking” (or similarly named) account.
3. The amount shown next to it is usually your “available balance”; if you tap it, you’ll often see both “current” and “available” balances plus recent transactions.

On the bank’s website:
1. Sign in to online banking.
2. Go to “Accounts” or “Account Summary.”
3. Find your checking account in the list; the balance will be shown on that row. Click into it for more detail.

At an ATM:
1. Insert your debit card and enter your PIN.
2. Choose “Balance Inquiry” or “Check Balance.”
3. Select your checking account when prompted.

If you tell me what you see (e.g., “current balance” vs “available balance”), I can explain the difference and help you figure out how much you can safely spend.</action>
